# Feel Your Protocol — Documentation Hub

> Entry point at docs.feelyourprotocol.org. Four doors, one protocol — pick where you belong, then dive deep.

## Fleet

- [Website Docs](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/index.html) — **For contributors.** Ship the next exploration. E-Components, workflow, architecture. Cyan "Builder's Workshop". Live.
- [MCP Server Docs](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/index.html) — **For agents & integrators.** Simulate tomorrow's chain today. Tool reference and setup. Launch week target: 5–9 Oct 2026.
- [Roadmap & Vision](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/index.html) — **For strategists & the curious.** See where this is headed. Vision, tracks, Phase 3 thinking. Purple "Strategy HQ". Live.
- [Community Token](https://community-token.feelyourprotocol.org/index.html) — **For holders & observers.** Radical transparency, plain language. Independently launched token on Base — not corporate-controlled. Amber community accent. Live.

## Binding ground

- [Main explorations website](https://feelyourprotocol.org/): Interactive Ethereum protocol explorations (Leg A)

## SEO note

Legacy URLs under docs.feelyourprotocol.org (except this landing page) permanently redirect to website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org with the same path.
